title: Earth
description: The starting point of the journey.

title: Troposphere
description: Earth's lowest atmospheric layer, containing most of the atmosphere and weather.

title: Stratosphere
description: A thin, cold atmospheric layer containing the ozone layer.

title: Mesosphere
description: The coldest atmospheric layer, where many incoming meteoroids burn up.

title: Kármán Line
description: A conventional boundary commonly used to mark the beginning of space.

title: Low Earth Orbit
description: The region of near-Earth space containing many satellites and spacecraft.

title: International Space Station
description: A continuously inhabited human space laboratory in low Earth orbit.

title: Animal Astronauts
description: Animals have been sent into space to investigate how living organisms respond to spaceflight.

title: Inner Van Allen Belt
description: A region of energetic charged particles trapped by Earth's magnetic field.

title: Outer Van Allen Belt
description: A second major region of trapped energetic particles surrounding Earth.

title: Space Debris
description: Human-made objects and fragments left in orbit, including inactive spacecraft and rocket hardware.

title: Deep Space
description: The journey becomes dominated by vast stretches of apparently empty space.

title: Solar Wind
description: Charged particles continuously flowing outward from the Sun.

title: Moon Approach
description: The Moon becomes increasingly prominent as the journey approaches its destination.

title: The Moon
description: The destination of the Earth-to-Moon journey.
